content: For all experiments, we admitted only experienced MTurk workers who are based in the US. One HIT consisted of writing one text for the text collection, formulating 15 questions for the question collection, or finding 15 pairs of answers for the answer collection. We paid $0.50 per HIT for the text and question collection, and $0.60 per HIT for the answer collection.
